answers.q1: Baked into the v0.3.3 fused d02/d03 program and date-dependent: d02/d03 TMN (consumed), wrfinput VEGFRA/shdfac and the aux4 SST/SEAICE/VEGFRA/ALBBCK series (both DEAD: the run reads its own traced copies). Geometry leaves identical across dates. [M]
answers.q2: TMN is time-constant within a run; differs between dates ONLY over water (TMN=SST(t0)); land TMN exactly date-invariant across 10 WN3 issues Jan-Aug and 4 W9N issues (max|dTMN| land = 0.0). The time-varying aux4 series are not consumed from the bake. [M]
answers.q3: Same month still bakes a different program (0702 vs 0707: water TMN rmse 0.68/0.79 K), but with the same zero output effect. [M]
answers.q4: 0707 24 h run with the wrongly loaded 0227 program (P) is whole-file byte-identical to the fresh compile (F) and to the AOT_VERIFY recompile (V) in all 72 wrfout files (d01-d03 x 24 h); frozen D6 P vs F: 0 failures, all RMSE 0; noise floor F-V = 0. [M]
answers.conclusion: v0.3.x cross-date fused cache hits change NO model output for the ALISIOS WN3 3-nest and (by identical land TMN + same masking code path) the W9N 9-nest geometry: the only consumed baked constant is water-cell TMN, confined to the dummy water-column Noah-MP land carry that never reaches the atmosphere, radiation or wrfout. [M for WN3 0227->0707 end-to-end; M source + M inputs for other dates/W9N]
answers.caveats: Restart checkpoints (if any) would carry the dummy water-column soil temperatures of the foreign TMN (never written to wrfout, no physical effect); a future case with date-varying LAND TMN (tmn_update=1 or a different real.exe source) would break the land-invariance premise -> GPUWRF_AOT_VERIFY=1 is the safe v0.3.x setting for shared caches (one fused lower per process; recompile ~6 min only on a foreign-date hit). v0.4.0 key v5 already separates dates; w41-bundlekey fix makes the fused program date-blind by construction.
